title: Respect as a Lens for the Design of AI Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Conceptual analysis of domestic voice assistants (e.g., Alexa, Siri) presenting submissive female personas and their responses to user harassment, evaluated through the proposed philosophical framework of respect and feminist theory.

Qualitative evaluation of dataset labeling practices (e.g., ImageNet) that associate socioeconomic status with derogatory descriptors (e.g., equating 'poor' with 'pathetic' or 'piteous'), analyzed as a form of evaluative disrespect.

Theoretical discussion of algorithmic harms, such as machine vision failing to recognize dark skin tones as human, evaluated using critiques of Kantian universalism, structural oppression, and intersectionality.
